Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume XI,
                    South Asia Crisis, 1971
291. Message From the
Soviet Leadership
to
                        President
Nixon
1
Moscow
,
December 13, 1971
.
We have attentively examined your message
2
over the direct
                        communications link. In accordance with the confidential exchange of
                        opinions existing between us, we are advising you that at the present time,
                        we are conducting a clarification of all the circumstances in India.
We will inform you of the results of the clarification without delay.
